title: tckedit
description:
Perform various editing operations on track files.

This command can be used to perform various types of manipulations on track data. A range of such manipulations are demonstrated in the examples provided below.

References:

include.description: specify an inclusion region of interest, as either a binary mask image, or as a sphere using 4 comma-separared values (x,y,z,radius). Streamlines must traverse ALL inclusion regions to be accepted.
include.title: include

include_ordered.description: specify an inclusion region of interest, as either a binary mask image, or as a sphere using 4 comma-separared values (x,y,z,radius). Streamlines must traverse ALL inclusion_ordered regions in the order they are specified in order to be accepted.
include_ordered.title: include_ordered

exclude.description: specify an exclusion region of interest, as either a binary mask image, or as a sphere using 4 comma-separared values (x,y,z,radius). Streamlines that enter ANY exclude region will be discarded.
exclude.title: exclude

mask.description: specify a masking region of interest, as either a binary mask image, or as a sphere using 4 comma-separared values (x,y,z,radius). If defined, streamlines exiting the mask will be truncated.
mask.title: mask

maxlength.description: set the maximum length of any streamline in mm
maxlength.title: maxlength

minlength.description: set the minimum length of any streamline in mm
minlength.title: minlength

number.description: set the desired number of selected streamlines to be propagated to the output file
number.title: number

skip.description: omit this number of selected streamlines before commencing writing to the output file
skip.title: skip

maxweight.description: set the maximum weight of any streamline
maxweight.title: maxweight

minweight.description: set the minimum weight of any streamline
minweight.title: minweight

inverse.description: output the inverse selection of streamlines based on the criteria provided; i.e. only those streamlines that fail at least one selection criterion, and/or vertices that are outside masks if provided, will be written to file
inverse.title: inverse

ends_only.description: only test the ends of each streamline against the provided include/exclude ROIs
ends_only.title: ends_only

tck_weights_in.description: specify a text scalar file containing the streamline weights
tck_weights_in.title: tck_weights_in

tck_weights_out.description: specify the path for an output text scalar file containing streamline weights
tck_weights_out.title: tck_weights_out

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help
